title: From Manufacturing Event Logs to Simulation: Enabling SMEs with Agentic AI for SimPy Simulation Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High expertise and cost barriers exclude small and medium-sized enterprises from discrete-event simulation (DES). We introduce GenAI4SimPy, a multi-agent framework powered by Qwen 3.6 (27B), an open-weight large language model, that automates end-to-end DES generation from manufacturing event logs to executable SimPy models through tool-augmented reasoning and human-in-the-loop validation. Evaluated on three execution blocks from a public smart factory dataset, the framework achieved a mean absolute percentage error of 7.9\% and coverage of failure rate for all three blocks and of throughput for two of three. A fidelity paradox was observed: accurate process-level parameters did not ensure system-level behavioral fidelity, with flow-time and throughput errors driven by misinterpreted observation-window truncation and absent system-level calibration. translated_title: 从制造事件日志到仿真：利用智能体AI赋能中小企业进行SimPy仿真生成
translated_abstract: 高昂的专业知识和成本门槛将中小企业排除在离散事件仿真（DES）之外。我们提出了GenAI4SimPy，一个由开放权重大型语言模型Qwen 3.6（27B）驱动的多智能体框架，通过工具增强推理和人机协同验证，实现从制造事件日志到可执行SimPy模型的端到端DES生成自动化。在公共智慧工厂数据集的三个执行区块上进行评估，该框架实现了7.9%的平均绝对百分比误差，并在全部三个区块上实现了故障率的覆盖率，在三个区块中的两个上实现了吞吐量的覆盖率。研究观察到一个保真度悖论：准确的过程级参数并不能保证系统级的行为保真度，流动时间和吞吐量误差源于对观察窗口截断的误解以及系统级校准的缺失。这些结果表明，本地开放权重模型可以以可接受的成本执行DES生成……
tldr: 提出了GenAI4SimPy多智能体框架，利用开放权重大语言模型Qwen 3.6将制造事件日志自动转化为可执行的SimPy离散事件仿真模型，并揭示了“保真度悖论”——过程级参数准确并不保证系统级行为保真。
en_tdlr: GenAI4SimPy, a multi-agent framework powered by the open-weight LLM Qwen 3.6, automates end-to-end discrete-event simulation generation from manufacturing event logs to executable SimPy models, while revealing a fidelity paradox in which accurate process-level parameters do not guarantee system-level behavioral fidelity.
